title: Single-record Maintenance Lifecycle Prototype
summary: 承接 Query / Detail baseline，收斂 Internal Enterprise Maintenance 的 Worklist-centric Create / Update / Read lifecycle、Capability、Validation、Dirty State、Save / Cancel 與 Mutation Policy decision point。
flow: Query / Worklist → Read / Create / Update → Capability → Validation / Dirty State → Save / Cancel → Mutation Policy → Return Query Context
